recommendation_summary: Right now: make one event per contract in the phone calendar, set 14 days before its notice deadline, with an alert that day and the deadline, renewal date and contract reference in the notes. Build these from each year's statement and check them against it. Cancellations and payments stay manual. No optional additions. Notification settings aren't confirmed, but the reply says the calendar wasn't inspected.
